timeline.tweet: I *do* exercise. I only smoke occasionally. I’m currently not drinking.

My wife thinks I complain to my friends about her because I used to do just that until she found out and told them all off. Fortunately for her, I don’t have friends to complain to any more, just the void.
My grandparents will die soon. I will spiral when this happens. Need to get goot at music recording now.
Learned that if I buy $100,000 in US Savings bonds every month for 12 months, I never have to work again. Wish I knew this like 10 years ago.
I imagined that when I joined the Navy, I would meet friends. That I would connect with other guys... but 6 years in I still have nothing.
Me: did you clean the garage? (While I worked for 8 hours + other errands) Wife: I didn’t know you wanted me to. We have two weeks before we move...

It’s not like I followed his career until death, or beyond the albums. I can’t quote more than a chorus or two. But the death of Eddie Van Halen feels like the death of an uncle or a cousin. It’s really got me messed up, & I’m not entirely sure why.
Its because I have no friends. That’s why Eddie’s death hit so hard. Familiarity is friendship when you have none. A change in that feels like another back stab.
Starting school again was the biggest mistake ever. Fuck my professor & fuck math.
